set.body:
Define the decision-complete contract before changing the solver.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-421-01: Specify fixed and moving roles, pull-map polarity, SE(3) update side, objective normalization, overlap treatment, robust-scale semantics, and termination states.
AC-421-02: Classify every relevant Volregger feature as canonical core, optional typed strategy, downstream QC or policy, benchmark-only evidence, or rejected legacy behavior.
AC-421-03: Define an independent full-affine continuous phantom renderer with asymmetric anatomy, anisotropic and oblique grids, seeded nuisance fields, supersampling, and exact Rigid3 truth.
AC-421-04: Classify tests as algebraic, analytic-oracle, differential, metamorphic, adversarial, regression, or performance evidence. Self-warped fixtures and Euler-column differences cannot serve as independent truth.
AC-421-05: Add the diagnostic contract comparing objective-at-truth with objective-at-recovered-pose so interpolation bias and optimizer failure cannot be conflated.
AC-421-06: The resulting contract and acceptance matrix are reviewed against PRD.json and docs/motion-evidence-plan.md with no ownership or dependency contradiction.
set.title: Specify the optimizer contract and independent oracle taxonomy
